packageRules.description: The astro + vite + cloudflare dev toolchain is tightly coupled: version skew between astro, vite, and the workerd runtime has broken `astro dev` before (vite 8.1.3+ with astro <=7.0.8). Never automerge these; each update must be approved from the dependency dashboard and verified with `bun dev` + `bun run build` locally.

satori 0.33+ bundles HarfBuzz (Emscripten) whose glue reads `self.location.href` under a WorkerGlobalScope. The Cloudflare prerenderer runs in workerd, which has no `location`, so `astro build` crashes on /preview routes. Cap until satori handles workerd.
